findings.F2: Sense 1 example 'in the behind position of the store' is unnatural and does not show the preposition.
findings.F3: Sense 2 signpost 'later or less advanced' exceeds three words.
findings.F4: Sense 1 signpost 'at the back of' exceeds three words.
findings.F5: Sense 2 has five examples, over the four-example limit.
